exercises.name: Rear-foot supported split squat
exercises.cue: Rest the top of your back foot on the chair seat. Lower slowly, keep your front knee over your ankle, then rise. Switch legs halfway.

exercises.name: Railing leg stretch
exercises.cue: Rest one heel on the rail, keep both legs long and lean forward gently from the hips. Hold, breathe, then switch legs.

exercises.name: Table shoulder stretch
exercises.cue: Hands on the table edge, step back and hinge forward until your back and shoulders open. Keep your neck relaxed.
